subject: planner: move pattern logic to cascades pkg (#57864)
summary: This commit is a mechanical refactor: it moves the `pattern` package from `pkg/planner/pattern` to `pkg/planner/cascades/pattern` and updates Go imports and Bazel deps across cascades memo/rule/old and memo. The moved pattern code itself is unchanged and has no init/side-effect behavior; it remains a leaf dependency (imports only `planner/core/base` and `planner/core/operator/logicalop`), so runtime planner semantics should be unaffected beyond the package path change. Repo-wide search shows no remaining references to the old import path/label, and later history up to `upstream/master` shows no subsequent changes to `pkg/planner/cascades/pattern` that would indicate a follow-up fix.
